links.outcome: After-hours EHR time, productivity, documentation completion and CPT deficiency after ambient scribe deployment
links.effect: Statistically significant worsening of after-hours EHR time; no practical change in productivity; no significant benefits to documentation or productivity measures; positive trends in provider engagement.
links.quote: There was a statistically significant worsening of after-hours EHR.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of Nuance DAX ambient clinical documentation on clinician engagement, EHR time, productivity, and safety compared to a matched control cohort.
